description: Provides an image puzzle with movable and rotatable pieces.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: Description of the image; falls back to the initial img alternative text.

attributes.name: exact-orientation
attributes.description: Starts every piece upright instead of randomly rotated; changing it restarts the game.

attributes.name: pieces
attributes.description: Exact number of pieces, from 1 to 144. A factor grid is chosen to approximate the image aspect ratio.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Square, interlocking, equilateral triangle or regular hexagon pieces.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL (SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG); overrides an initial img child. Changing it starts a new game.

methods.name: place(id: number, x: number, y: number, angle?: number): boolean
methods.description: Places a piece in SVG cell units; angles must be multiples of the shape’s rotation step (90° or 60°). Snaps near its solution and clamps to the board.

methods.name: redo(): void
methods.description: Reapplies the most recently undone move.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Shuffles pieces into the tray and starts a fresh move history.

methods.name: showImage(show = true): void
methods.description: Displays or hides the reference image in the target frame without changing placements.

events.name: tp-puzzle-change
events.description: Emitted after a placement, rotation, undo, redo or shuffle; placements are independent copies.

events.name: tp-puzzle-complete
events.description: Emitted when a move first completes the current arrangement.

events.name: tp-puzzle-error
events.description: Emitted when the configuration or image cannot be loaded.

events.name: tp-puzzle-load
events.description: Emitted when the image is loaded and the pieces are ready.
events.detail: { pieces: number; rows: number; columns: number }

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-button
dependencies.summary: Button component that supports native button and link rendering.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-puzzle>` element provides an image puzzle with movable and rotatable pieces.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Drag a piece | Moves it with a mouse, pen or touch. An upright piece snaps near its correct target. |
| Right-click a piece | Opens its rotation menu at the pointer. |
| Rotate +90° / Rotate −90° or Rotate +60° / Rotate −60° | Rotates the selected piece clockwise or counterclockwise by 90° (square/interlocking) or 60° (triangle/hexagon), from the menu or toolbar. |
| Show image | Toggles the reference image in the target frame without changing placements. |
| Undo / Redo | Reverses or reapplies an accepted move or rotation. |
| Shuffle | Rearranges every piece in the tray and clears move history. |
| Click outside the rotation menu | Closes the menu. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves focus through controls and pieces. |
| Arrow keys | Moves the focused piece by 0.05 cell units; hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> for 0.25 units. |
| <kbd>R</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>R</kbd> | Rotates the focused piece by ±90° (square/interlocking) or ±60° (triangle/hexagon). |
| <kbd>ContextMenu</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd> | Opens the focused piece's rotation menu. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Cancels a drag or closes the rotation menu and returns focus to the selected piece. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> / <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> | Undoes or redoes a move while a piece is focused. <kbd>Command</kbd> is also accepted. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activates a focused toolbar button or menu action. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Opens User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to focus. <kbd>Shift</kbd> may be needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Opens contextual component documentation. |
